prompt: Which team became the first team to claim back-to-back Asian Cup titles?
answer:
Qatar became the first team since Japan (2000 and 2004) to win back-to-back AFC Asian Cup titles, retaining the trophy in 2023 after winning in 2019.  

Historically, however, South Korea was the first-ever back-to-back champion, winning in 1956 and 1960.
